# OS Technology

OS Technology Limited helps small businesses establish, manage and improve their digital setup: websites, professional email, Microsoft 365, hosting, cybersecurity and IT support. Based in Beverley, East Yorkshire, serving businesses locally and throughout the UK. Microsoft CSP indirect reseller.

- [Business technology services and managed plans](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business)
- [Case studies](https://ostechnology.uk/case-studies): website rebuilt within 24 hours, ten domains consolidated into one Microsoft 365 tenant, and 20+ logins moved into a password manager. These are individual project results; the password work followed the ten-domain project for the same client.
- [Microsoft 365](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/modern-workplace)
- [Cybersecurity](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/cybersecurity)
- [Websites and digital presence](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/web-presence): the overview for websites, business email, domains and Google Business Profiles.
- [Website design](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/website-design): simple business websites from £100 one-off for one responsive brochure page using client-supplied content, with business information and contact details. OS Technology hosting is required from £10/month. Domains and email cost extra. No VAT is charged. Additional pages, enquiry forms, functionality and content creation are estimated separately. Complete business setup and website modernisation receive tailored estimates.
- [Business email setup](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/business-email): own-domain email, new mailboxes, secure sign-ins and clear account ownership.
- [Microsoft 365 migration](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/microsoft-365-migration): moving existing email, discovery, agreed cutover and post-migration checks.
- [Hosting and domains](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/hosting-domains): web services starting from £10 per month, domain registration/transfers, DNS management and ongoing technical maintenance. Domains and email are priced separately. No VAT is charged.
- [Industries](https://ostechnology.uk/industries): ten office-based sectors. Specialist business applications remain supported by their vendors.
- [Locations](https://ostechnology.uk/locations): twelve East Riding coverage pages. Visits, scope and charges are agreed in advance; no arrival-time guarantee is published.
- [About](https://ostechnology.uk/about)
- [Products and partners](https://ostechnology.uk/partners)
- [Insights](https://ostechnology.uk/blog)
- [Free small business technology review](https://ostechnology.uk/small-business-technology-review)
- [Home Support](https://ostechnology.uk/services/home): existing Personal and Family remote support plans.

Starter, Standard and Premium managed plans are scoped in a written proposal. There is no minimum contract term. Starter remote support includes 1 hour free across the business. Standard remote support is included. Premium unlimited remote support is subject to fair use. Software licences are billed separately. Helpdesk hours are 9:00–17:00 business days for Starter and Standard, and 8:00–18:00 business days for Premium. Response arrangements are specified in the proposal. Round-the-clock monitoring does not extend helpdesk hours.

Enquiries: hello@ostechnology.uk. Company number 17261969.

## Markdown for agents

Every page is also available as clean Markdown. Send `Accept: text/markdown` to a page URL or request its `.md` path, such as https://ostechnology.uk/about.md. HTML remains the default representation for browsers.
